subject: Re: Kickoff - resourcing, and we need a rating tool
body:
Ulla,

Staffing:
- Yara Jokic 55%, DARC implementation and the classifier training.
- Milan Zapata 40%, production transition extraction.
- Chiara Olsen 30%, simulator harness.
- Paloma Castillo, see below.

Compute: 32 GPUs on titan-a100, best-effort is fine, these are small policies.

The gap in your Jun 10 milestone is "human plausibility ratings". We have no tooling for that. Sending raters a folder of rollout videos and a spreadsheet is how you get unusable labels.

So we are building a human-rating annotation UI from scratch: side-by-side rollout playback, a 5-point plausibility scale, keyboard-driven navigation, rater agreement tracking and an export path into our eval store. Paloma Castillo owns it at 50% from April 20; first usable build April 30. It's about three weeks and we'll want it for every transfer project after this one.

Deshawn
